# Data Source: identitynow_service_desk_integration

Use this data source to look up a service desk integration by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_service_desk_integration" "servicenow" {
  name = "ServiceNow"
}
```

Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Service desk integration ID. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Service desk integration name. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `attributes_json` (String, Sensitive) Integration attributes as a JSON object, as returned by the API. The value is sensitive.
- `before_provisioning_rule` (Attributes List) Before provisioning rule, a list with at most one item with `id`, `type` and `name`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--before_provisioning_rule))
- `cluster_ref` (Attributes List) Virtual appliance cluster of the integration, a list with at most one item with `id`, `type` and `name`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cluster_ref))
- `created` (String) Creation date.
- `description` (String) Description of the integration.
- `managed_sources` (List of String) IDs of the sources managed by the integration.
- `modified` (String) Last modification date.
- `owner_ref` (Attributes List) Identity that owns the integration, a list with at most one item with `id`, `type` and `name`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner_ref))
- `provisioning_config_json` (String) Provisioning configuration as a JSON object.
- `type` (String) Service desk integration type.
